However, the prompt template provided to models explicitly includes trailing text: `ADMISSIBILITY: (MANDATORY, FFAFP §15) state PASS/FAIL for each of S_min...`. This triggers the §17 feedback channel to incorrectly penalize the model for missing the admissibility block, even when it was provided perfectly according to the template.
